scope: Independent source review of exact product/test/manifests/controller diff; not Apple compilation or native acceptance.
findings: Collection owner is weak, assigned before state setters and content configuration, and cleared before super.prepareForReuse.
Configuration state takes the actual current editing authority from the owner; absent owner retains UIKit super state. Existing lock/moving flags remain intact.
Only the original EditorPageController production setter call site changes; initial focus/lifetime implementation remains unchanged.
First-insertion regression supplies initial focus before any first item is displayed, with both true and false collection editing states.
Initially denied focus remains cancelled after changing collection editing alone; fresh explicit focus is separately required to work.
Exact manifest adds one parameterized method with two literal cases; negative controls reject missing/duplicate/failed/skipped cases.
Acceptance branch gate adds only the exact named UI-resume branch, retaining source/ref checks and a mismatch rejection.
